def feats(g,col):
    out=[]
    cs=comps(g,col)
    S=set()
    allc={(y,x) for y in range(len(g)) for x in range(len(g[0]))}

prog='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    c = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v)
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if grid[i][j] == c and (i, j) not in seen:
                q = deque([(i, j)]); seen.add((i, j)); cells = []
                while q:
                    y, x = q.popleft(); cells.append((y, x))
                    for dy in (-1, 0, 1):
                        for dx in (-1, 0, 1):
                            n = (y + dy, x + dx)
                            if 0 <= n[0] < h and 0 <= n[1] < w and grid[n[0]][n[1]] == c and n not in seen:
                                seen.add(n); q.append(n)
                comps.append(cells)
    # pick smallest component with odd cell count (smaller wins on tie)
    best = min(comps, key=lambda cl: (len(cl) % 2 == 0, len(cl)))
    ys = [y for y, x in best]; xs = [x for y, x in best]
    y0, x0 = min(ys), min(xs)
    hh = max(ys) - y0 + 1; ww = max(xs) - x0 + 1
    sub = [[0] * ww for _ in range(hh)]
    for y, x in best:
        sub[y - y0][x - x0] = c
    return sub
'''
